patch.value: Release changelog generate and check derived the section name from two different sources

The daily release job runs a generate step (npm run changelog, --mode prepend --since-previous-tag --until-release-tag --release-version-from-package) followed by a check step (npm run changelog:check, --mode replace --all-release-tags --release-version-from-package --check). At release time package.json is already bumped to the pending version, but the release tag is not pushed until the final step, so --until-release-tag cannot resolve the pending tag and the generate writes the section as '## Unreleased' while --release-version-from-package on the check side derives the same section as '## <version> - <date>'. The two commands disagree by construction, the check exits 1, and the release has failed every day since 2026-08-08 with no self-recovery path. Fix: make the release-time generate and check a byte-identical pair that names the pending section after the tag being created via an explicit --version, mirroring pm-changelog; and redefine the PR-time changelog:check as 'npm run changelog -- --check' so the PR pair cannot drift either.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
END-TO-END PROOF (scratch copy /tmp/pmctx-sim, package.json bumped to 2026.8.9, tag v2026.08.09 not yet pushed):

OLD pair (the bug) - generate derived the name from --until-release-tag (no tag yet -> Unreleased), check derived it from --release-version-from-package (-> version):
  generate wrote heading: '## Unreleased'
  check diff: -## Unreleased  +## 2026.8.9 - 2026-08-08
  check exit code: 1  (release could not pass)

NEW pair (the fix) - both invocations byte-identical apart from --github-step-summary vs --check, both pass --version v2026.08.09:
  generate wrote heading: '## 2026.8.9 - 2026-08-08'  (named after the tag, normalized to unpadded)
  check: 'Changelog is up to date'
  check exit code: 0
  RELEASE_NOTES.md section: '## 2026.8.9 - 2026-08-08' with the unreleased item folded in.

Also verified the reordered 'Run release checks' (prepend changelog:check) passes against the committed CHANGELOG BEFORE the generate step mutates it (exit 0), matching pm-changelog's release-workflow ordering.

It parses .github/workflows/release.yml with a dependency-free recursive-descent YAML parser, navigates to the 'Generate changelog and release notes' step run block, and asserts the two pm-changelog invocations are byte-identical apart from the terminal flag (--github-step-summary vs --check), and that --version is present. The test immediately proved its worth: it caught a typo (unbrained vs unbraind) I introduced in the generate --item-url-base before I committed.

patch.value: Fixed the release-time changelog generate/check desynchronization: the release workflow now runs a byte-identical pm-changelog generate+check pair that names the pending section after the tag via an explicit --version (mirroring pm-changelog), with 'Run release checks' reordered before the generate step so the prepend-mode changelog:check still validates committed state. Redefined changelog:check as 'npm run changelog -- --check' so the PR-time pair cannot drift. Added test/release-workflow-sync.test.ts that parses the workflow YAML and locks the pair in sync. Verified end-to-end: new pair exits 0 with heading '## 2026.8.9 - 2026-08-08'; old pair exited 1. All gates green (typecheck, 196 tests, 100/100/100 coverage, changelog:check).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
REVIEW ROUND 2 — CodeRabbit x7 + Sourcery x3 on PR #55 (branch release-changelog-named-after-tag). Prior round's fix (the byte-identical generate/check pair) is unchanged and re-verified; this round addresses the seven CodeRabbit and three Sourcery findings on top of it.

1. [Major] changelog:check removed from release:check (package.json). At release time package.json is already bumped while the tag is not pushed, so the prepend-mode changelog:check would demand an '## Unreleased' heading exactly when generate replaces it. release:check is now typecheck+build+coverage+audit+pack, mirroring pm-changelog's 'Run release checks' (check/test/audit/pack, deliberately no changelog:check). PR-time coverage now lives in ci.yml: 'Verify generated changelog (pending section)' -> npm run changelog:check, plus the new 'Verify full changelog history' -> npm run changelog:full:check. ci.yml OWNS the PR-time check. Step order restored to fleet-normal (Generate changelog -> Run release checks): the prior swap existed only so changelog:check could validate committed state before generate mutated it; with it out of release:check, the reason is gone.

2. [Minor] Empty-notes guard: the step now fails when sed matches no '## ' heading. Verified it FIRES — prose-only input -> 0-byte RELEASE_NOTES.md -> guard exits 1; input with a heading -> 47-byte file -> exit 0.

3. [Trivial] Tag flows via env (RELEASE_TAG), not inline ${{ }} expansion, matching 'Check release ref'. zizmor template-injection surface removed.

4. [Trivial/regression] Added changelog:full:check (npm run changelog:full -- --check), run in ci.yml. Restores the full-history coverage the old changelog:check gave before it was narrowed to the pending section. The new check immediately caught real drift: pm-context-cilu was missing from ## Unreleased (closed after the last release). Fixed by regenerating the full CHANGELOG.

5. [Major] Test now asserts step ORDER (generate index < release-checks index), not just existence. Verified: reordering the steps fails the test.

6. [Major] Test now asserts the VALUE after --version is the pending-tag expr ($RELEASE_TAG) in the shared common array (covers both generate and check: they expand the same array and are proven byte-identical). Verified: changing --version to $NPM_VERSION fails the test.

7. [Trivial] Removed the dead firstEntry reassignment in the test's parseMapping.

8. [Sourcery] Collapsed the three pm-changelog invocations into one shared common=(...) bash array so generate/check/notes cannot drift; removed the stale release:notes npm script (it still carried --since-previous-tag --until-release-tag while the workflow inlined --all-release-tags --version ... --limit 1). Sync test still proves generate≡check apart from the terminal flag.

9. [Sourcery judgement] No maintained YAML parser in node_modules — require.resolve fails for both js-yaml and yaml, and a directory walk finds none. Kept the hand-rolled recursive-descent parser, documented why (scoped to the workflow-YAML subset; adding a dependency for one test is the larger cost).

EVIDENCE: typecheck clean; 196 tests pass; coverage 100.00/100.00/100.00 (thresholds UNCHANGED). Release sim (scratch copy /tmp/pmctx-sim, package.json bumped to 2026.8.9, tag v2026.08.09 not pushed): new generate/check pair (common array, --version v2026.08.09) wrote heading '## 2026.8.9 - 2026-08-08'; check exit 0 ('Changelog is up to date'); notes (--stdout --limit 1) emitted the same section. changelog:check (pending) exit 0; changelog:full:check exit 0 after regenerate. audit:prod 0 vulnerabilities; pack:dry-run 13 files.

patch.value: Addressed PR #55 review round (7 CodeRabbit + 3 Sourcery findings): removed changelog:check from release:check (release-time hazard gone; ci.yml now owns PR-time changelog:check plus the new changelog:full:check); restored fleet-normal generate-then-release-checks order; added an empty-RELEASE_NOTES.md guard (verified it fires); passed the tag via env not inline expansion; restored full-history changelog coverage; collapsed the three release pm-changelog invocations into one shared common array and removed the stale release:notes script; hardened the sync test to assert step order and the --version value (both regressions proven to fail); removed the dead reassignment; kept the hand-rolled YAML parser (no maintained parser in node_modules). All gates green (typecheck, 196 tests, 100/100/100 coverage, audit, pack, both changelog checks).
